White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt is stepping down at the end of August after serving since January 2025. President Trump announced her departure, noting she will remain a key outside adviser.

Honoring personal boundaries and family needs without burning professional bridges or abandoning core political coalitions.

Evaluating the personal WHAT (family time) versus the institutional WHO (political positioning). No bait-and-switch detected, just a standard high-level career evolution.
